title: Business meeting to consider the nominations of Jeremy Wiggins, of the District of Columbia, to be an Assistant Secretary of the Treasury, Matthew Jones, of Virginia, to be an Assistant Secretary of Housing and Urban Development, and David Slade, of Florida, to be First Vice President, and Michael Rigas, of Virginia, to be a Member of the Board of Directors, both of the Export-Import Bank of the United States; to be immediately followed by an open hearing to examine the nominations of Mark Aesch, of Florida, to be Federal Transit Administrator, and Hugo Dante, Jr., of Alabama, to be Director, Office of Financial Research, and Rebekah Jurata, of California, to be an Assistant Secretary, both of the Department of the Treasury, and Kristin N. Johnson, of Michigan, and Steven Levine, of Maryland, both to be a Member of the Securities and Exchange Commission.
